paper_title: First constraints on QCD axion dark matter using James Webb Space Telescope observations
notes: New constraints on QCD axion dark matter from JWST blank-sky observations using MIRI (0.1-0.5 eV) and NIRSpec (0.5-4 eV) spectrographs. Data points extracted from Figure 2 by visual inspection of the exclusion curve. The paper reports 95% confidence limits derived from χ² analysis with ∆χ² ≤ 3.84. DM density profile assumed: NFW with rs=24 kpc, ρs=0.18 GeV/cm³. Constraints improve over previous studies by >2 orders of magnitude in some mass ranges. Systematic uncertainties discussed in appendices include background subtraction (up to 7% variation with polynomial order), DM profile choice (up to 36% in 0.8-1.5 eV range), and Galactic plane contamination (up to 64% in 0.8-1.5 eV range). Analysis uses 15,419 MIRI and 3,639 NIRSpec blank-sky observations. Extraction confidence reduced from 0.9 to 0.75 due to data points being read from figure rather than provided in tabular form. | selector: text (sole candidate)
